contexts.summaryJa: ヨシュア記14:4は、ヨセフの子らをマナセ族とエフライム族の二部族として記します。
contexts.wiki: 記事はヨセフの部族を扱い、エフライムとマナセをその二集団として述べます。

contexts.summaryJa: ヨシュア記17:1は、マナセの相続を述べる中で、ヨセフをマナセの父として系譜に記します。
contexts.wiki: 記事はヤコブの子ヨセフを扱い、ヨシュア記17:1でマナセの父として記される人物と対応します。

contexts.summaryJa: ヨシュア記13:31は、マキルの子らにギレアデの半分などが与えられたと述べ、マキルをマナセの子と記します。
contexts.identityNoteJa: ヨシュア記13:31では、相続を受けるマキルの子らと、彼らの祖先として記されるマナセが系譜で結ばれています。
contexts.wiki: 記事は族長マナセを扱います。ヨシュア記13:31ではマキルの父として名が記されます。

contexts.summaryJa: ヨシュア記15:6はユダの境界標として「ルベンの子ボハンの石」を挙げます。父をルベンと呼びますが、族祖と同一か、世代がどれほど隔たるかは本文から分かりません。
contexts.identityNoteJa: ヨシュア記15:6は「ルベンの子ボハンの石」と記しますが、父ルベンの世代を示しません。
contexts.wiki: 記事の「Biblical references」節は、ヨシュア記15:6の「ルベンの子ボハンの石」に触れます。父ルベンと族祖ルベンの同一性や世代関係は本文から定まりません。

facts.textJa: ヨシュア記18:17も、「ルベンの子ボハンの石」を境界の目印として挙げます。

contexts.identityNoteJa: ヨシュア記24:4では、ヤコブはイサクの子としてエサウと並べて名指されます。
contexts.wiki: 記事はイサクの子ヤコブについて説明し、ヨシュア記24:4で名指される人物と一致します。

after.textJa: ヨシュア記16:1はヨセフの子らの領地の境界を記し、16:4はマナセとエフライムが相続を受けたと述べます。

changes.reasonJa: 本文で16:1と16:4の双方を引用していたため、両方のWEB sourceIdを付けた。

The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

changes.before: text cited JOS17:14–18 but knownBy 17:17 and sourceIds only 17:17

after.textJa: ヨシュア記17:14ではヨセフの子らが土地について申し立て、17:17ではヨシュアがエフライムとマナセに語りかけます。

changes.reasonJa: 18節までを含む引用範囲を削り、17:14・17:17の主張に限定。knownBy17:17を維持し両節を引用した。

changes.reasonJa: 本文で18:5と18:11双方を説明するため、両方のWEB sourceIdを付けた。

primaryWitnesses.text: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.
The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

contextFacts.before: ヨシュア記17:2は、マナセの子ヨセフの子孫を各家族に分けて列挙します。
contextFacts.after: ヨシュア記17:2は、ヨセフの子マナセの子らを家族ごとに列挙します。
contextFacts.sourceText: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
contextFacts.reasonJa: 固定WEBは「Manasseh the son of Joseph」と明記するため、ヨセフをマナセの子と読ませる親子逆転を訂正。氏族列挙を家族単位の子らと記す。

sourceRationaleJa.text: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim...
sourceRationaleJa.decision: collective Joseph profile introduction limited to this verse; 24:32 burial material remains in a later fact.
sourceRationaleJa.fixedWitnessText: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.

sourceRationaleJa.text: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh...
sourceRationaleJa.decision: Joseph person introduction only states the father relation here; 24:32 burial is gated as a fact.
sourceRationaleJa.fixedWitnessText: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

sourceRationaleJa.text: ...were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh...
sourceRationaleJa.decision: Manasseh profile uses the genealogical relationship available in this verse; later narrative comparison removed.
sourceRationaleJa.fixedWitnessText: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.

sourceRationaleJa.text: ...the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
sourceRationaleJa.decision: Reuben intro describes only this boundary marker; the JOS18:17 repetition is now a fact gated at 18:17.
sourceRationaleJa.fixedWitnessText: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

sourceRationaleJa.text: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau... Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
sourceRationaleJa.decision: Jacob context note states the explicit naming and relation at this verse without product/editorial language.
sourceRationaleJa.fixedWitnessText: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
